Class StudentGraph

java.lang.Object
StudentGraph
public class StudentGraph extends Object
Represents the social graph of many UniversityStudents in Longhorn Network. Each student is a node in the graph and each edge between students will be weighted by their connection strength.

  • Constructor Details

    • StudentGraph

      public StudentGraph(List<UniversityStudent> students)
      Constructs a StudentGraph form the given list of students. Will add each student as a node into the graph, compute connection strength between pairs of students, and add weighted/undirected edges for non-zero strengths.
      Parameters:
      students - is the list of students to include in the graph

  • Method Details

    • addStudent

      public void addStudent(UniversityStudent student)

      Parameters:
      student - to be added

    • addEdge

      public void addEdge(UniversityStudent student1, UniversityStudent student2, int weight)
      Adds a weighted edge between 2 students. Graph is undirected so the weight is stored for student1 and student2
      Parameters:
      student1 - one endpoint of the weighted connection edge
      student2 - other endpoint of the weighted connection edge
      weight - is the connection strength between student1 and student2
